magmom_note: Initial collinear moments, not constrained or converged local moments; repetition counts follow each reconstructed one-H composition and atom ordering.

frozen.initial_structure: H-free dump host plus exactly one selected candidate H

non_frozen.initial_structure: same reconstructed one-H structure as frozen branch

zero_point_energy.site_protocol: harmonic finite differences; displace only H while holding all host atoms fixed; use three local H modes
